nom: SUNDAY RILEY Auto Correct Brightening and Depuffing Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers who describe dry under-eyes report the cream helps with hydration and brightening in that area.
segments.combination: One reviewer who describes her skin as dry but prone to getting oily and breaking out with the wrong products reports this cream is gentle, non-greasy and did not irritate her.
segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin split sharply: several describe severe burning, swelling, itching, peeling or a rash lasting about a week, often tied to the glycolic acid or fragrance ingredients, while many others with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, report no irritation at all along with good hydration and brightening.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their thirties through sixties report visibly softened crow's feet and fine lines, less puffiness and brighter under-eyes with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who mention fine lines and crow's feet, including several in their thirties to sixties, report visibly softened lines and firmer-looking skin with regular use; a couple say it improved brightness and puffiness but made no visible difference to their fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the under-eye area as more hydrated, supple and plump after use, including one who specifically sought help for dry under-eyes; no reviewer describes it as drying.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers link the fragrance and acid ingredients to redness alongside burning and irritation, with one still red and irritated a week after a single use; one reviewer separately credits an ingredient with a soothing, redness-reducing effect.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the formula's ingredients with helping build the moisture barrier and strengthen the delicate skin around the eyes; this is an isolated mention.

aspects.libelle: Burning or stinging sensation on application
Off, rancid scent reported in some batches
Elegant glass bottle with pump dispenser
Packaging traps product, hard to use it all
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I used this eye cream for 2 days and had to stop becasue my face is swollen with an itchy rash!! I have sensitive skin but good lord this is awful. Ive nevwr had anything like this. Can't seem to get the swelling down and the rash to go away. Please test on hand before using. Will be returning.

I absolutely love Sunday Riley. After great experience with the whole line I use this brand only for skincare. I received a sample of Auto-Correct with a collection set I purchased. One use and it literally burned my eyelids. The pain, itching, peeling, burning and general pain was a shock to me. Obviously I would never use this again. Seems like other reviewers say its the glycolic acid causing this issue, which I have used before in other products without a reaction. Either way, if you are sensitive to that or have sensitive skin in general, I woild highly recommend you be careful with this one. One week on and my eyes are still peeling, red and iritated.

I purchased this product a little over a week ago and ever since I've been pretty good about applying both AM and PM. I realize no product is an immediate miracle worker, but I think this eye cream may fool some people because it has "brightening" properties (basically a shimmery, lightening TINT). I appreciate the brightness it brings, but I fear I didn't purchase appropriately for the issues I was truly trying to combat. I've read some folks have experienced a burning sensation. My first application I had that experience, but I think my skin may be sensitive to caffeine (this happened when I used an Ordinary eye serum with caffeine and/or I over retinol'd so my skin was extra sensitive that day). After that first time, I never had that burning sensation and I have super sensitive skin, rosacea, KP, the works... I haven't had or used this product enough to have a definitive opinion, but what I've gathered so far is this is a great QUICK FIX, not necessary something that will help combat/prevent/deal with long term under eye concerns (bags, dark circles, wrinkles). I honestly am not convinced that eye creams are that effective in general. I think targeting dark circles and bags is better dealt with with under eye masks, cold compresses, tea bags.. and if you are adequately moisturizing your face, it's not that necessary to incorporate an eye cream. Lay it on thick at night, if you have dry normal greasy skin... what i've learned is oily skin is a reaction to your skin crying

Ive always loved eye creams especially since i have dry under eyes. But i hadnt found one that really helped wth dark circles just helped wth hydration. Well after trying Auto Correct, i can honestly say this eye cream has helped wth hydration but has actually has made my under eyes brighter. I barely have to use color corrector

Hit my 30's and started searching for solutions to help with the light facial puffiness I see in the AM. I use this as part of my morning skin care routine, just before I apply my makeup. A tiny bead is all you need and I pat it under my eyes, between my brows & on the brow bone. Its even nice for the allergy season where my nose and nasolabial folds have a touch of puff to them! It works well with my non-silicone makeup products, doesnt leave my skin greasy, and is gentle enough for daily use without irritation. My skin type: dry but can get oily (causing breakouts) quick with the wrong products.

Great eye serum that isnt sticky or greasy. It does what it says it does. No eye cream will turn you 21 again, but if you look at the ingredients and more importantly the order they are listed in on the back, you should have enough of a reason to try it. Its the most potent "clean" skincare i have found. (A zillion times more effective and than Pacifica.) It can get expensive yes but you can put together a decent AM and PM routine using only about 4 or 5 of their items. I use Auto Correct, C.E.O., Good Genes, Pink Drink, and Retinol A+, and it has been a revelation. My skin actually glows. I am in my forties with some skin laxity and eye bags, and i can tell the difference almost immediately between what is working and what is not. I will be using this eye cream now as long as they keep making it.

I received this complimentary from Sunday Riley in exchange for my honest review. At 40, my eyes are starting to show my age. It's inevitable and while I've come to accept the march of time, I still love when I can throw it off beat a little. Using this cream 2x daily for a week softened my crows feet and reduces puffiness under my eyes as well. I may not look 20, but I definitely look better rested and more hydrated.

reserve: Most reviews center on dark circles and puffiness, which fall outside the concern categories used here, so this segmentation does not capture the product's most frequently reported benefit.
